properties.NAME: Kingdom of Benin
properties.NOTE: Upstream labels this polygon in southern Nigeria 'Sotho' (a people of southern Africa). It sits on the Edo Kingdom of Benin, which lasted until the British annexation of 1897.

properties.NAME: Taiwan Prefecture (Qing)
properties.NOTE: Upstream leaves Taiwan unnamed in 1800. The Qing annexed it in 1684 and ruled it as a prefecture of Fujian until 1895; effective control was mostly the western plains.
